direction_count.note: a study resolving every contested choice the same way is how a lean survives an audit of its steps. This is a flag and not a failure.

judgements.name: the central lens
judgements.alternative: the retired 45/15/20/20 blend of four lenses
judgements.why_not_repriced: three of the four lenses in that blend were retired with it and are not built by this model, so the alternative cannot be run against the current numbers. The figure beside it is what it was worth when it was retired, and it is named as that rather than carried as current.
judgements.why: three of the four blended lenses value a developer on reported earnings and historical-cost book, which for a company whose worth sits in an undelivered order book measures a floor; and the weights had never cleared any out-of-sample test

judgements.name: the discount rate's shape
judgements.adopted: a rate that glides with the house Egyptian macro path
judgements.alternative: a flat rate held for the whole window and the perpetuity
judgements.why: holding a crisis-level rate to year fifteen and into perpetuity asserts that Egypt never normalises, while this study's own cost of debt already follows the disinflation path

judgements.name: the length of the explicit window
judgements.adopted: fifteen years, run until growth meets the terminal
judgements.alternative: five years, as the earlier editions carried
judgements.why: a five-year window closes while deliveries are still compounding, so the terminal capitalises a growth rate the model never reached

judgements.name: terminal growth
judgements.adopted: the house Egyptian terminal at zero real growth
judgements.why: 12% nominal in perpetuity is above Egypt's own long-run nominal GDP in the same currency, which makes the company the economy eventually

judgements.name: the delivery path
judgements.adopted: the disclosed run of handovers, fading
judgements.alternative: the 15% run held flat across the window
judgements.why_not_repriced: the fade is built into the model's own delivery ladder rather than exposed as a parameter, so holding it flat is a rebuild and not a re-run. Named as the edition it was priced at.
judgements.why: the company's own handover record fades; holding the peak year flat for fifteen years is a claim about something it has not done
